scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @kobako/db build && exec node apps/web/scripts/dev.mjs dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @kobako/db build && pnpm --filter @kobako/db typecheck && pnpm --filter @kobako/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @kobako/worker typecheck
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @kobako/db build && exec node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @kobako/db build && pnpm --filter @kobako/web build && pnpm --filter @kobako/worker build
scripts.db:generate: cd packages/db && exec node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env node_modules/drizzle-kit/bin.cjs generate --config drizzle.config.ts
